{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Surge Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  statuses: write

concurrency:
  group: surge-preview-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Cache node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: surge-preview-node-modules-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}-${{ hashFiles('package.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            surge-preview-node-modules-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}-"
  ,
  "rationale": "The Surge Preview workflow runs `npm install` on every pull request with no dependency cache, while concurrency cancel-in-progress (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is already present. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) is a supported reviewed pattern with reported benefit and fits: repeated dependency fetching on PRs is measurable, no equivalent cache exists, and the change caches only dependency install state (node_modules) keyed on the lockfile/package.json while keeping `npm install` and the build/deploy steps intact, so required checks and coverage are preserved. Build outputs (docs-dist) are not cached, and no secrets, privileged actions, or deployment changes are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
